headline.title: First flakes for Northern Vermont.
headline.text: Up to {{s:2.3}} on the summit of Jay Peak Monday morning to Monday afternoon, and {{s:7.6}} for the week. 5 of the 31 resorts close to opening get nights cold enough to make snow, mostly in Western Maine and White Mountains. Killington typically opens first, around Nov 8.

BTV.excerpt:
A cooler and unsettled weather pattern is expected this weekend with some summit level wet snow possible on Sunday morning.
Continued unsettled flow with temperatures falling towards the end of next week.

ALY.excerpt:
) Medium to high chances for rain showers tomorrow across eastern New York and western New England, with no flooding impacts expected.
) Unsettled weather conditions are favored for across eastern New York and western New England next week.

GYX.excerpt:
Beneficial rainfall expands inland tonight with locally heavy rainfall along the coast with more showery conditions expected this weekend.
Cooler temperatures arrive later this weekend and remain through next week areawide. There will be multiple chances for light precipitation, including light snow or snow showers for the higher peaks of the White Mountains.

BUF.excerpt: ) Unsettled weather and cooler temperatures through the weekend.

PHI.excerpt:
A weak, slow moving cold front will continue to push across the area this afternoon bringing some additional rounds of showers. The rain is not expected to be as heavy as what occurred earlier this morning and will taper off west to east through the late afternoon into this evening.
The weekend will begin with drier and cooler with breezy conditions for Saturday in the wake of a departing low pressure system. Winds will diminish with temperatures moderating some for Sunday.

CTP.excerpt: ) Trending seasonably cooler this weekend into next week with bulk of precipitation confined near and southeast of Lake Erie

writeups.name: Vermont
writeups.title: Some snow Monday morning, best at Jay Peak.
paras: Light snow Monday morning to Monday afternoon: Jay Peak {{s:2.3}}, Smugglers' Notch {{s:2}}, Stowe {{s:1.2}} at the summits, though the models range from {{r:0.4,6.4}} at Jay Peak. It's a northwest upslope setup, one that usually favors Jay Peak, Smugglers' Notch and Stowe. Rain mixes in at the bases.
Next two days: summit temperatures from {{t:30}} to {{t:57}}, with rain at times.
Killington usually opens first here, around Nov 8. Jay Peak gets the most hours cold enough to make snow this week (about 7).
NWS Burlington forecasters, Friday 2:05 PM: "A cooler and unsettled weather pattern is expected this weekend with some summit level wet snow possible on Sunday morning."
writeups.outlook: Days 8 to 14: NOAA's outlook leans slightly warmer than normal and slightly drier than normal.

writeups.name: New Hampshire
writeups.title: Some snow Saturday afternoon, best at Cannon.
paras: Light snow Saturday afternoon to Sunday morning: Cannon {{s:2.1}}, Bretton Woods {{s:1.6}}, Wildcat {{s:0.7}} at the summits, though the models range from {{r:0.4,7.5}} at Cannon. It's a northwest upslope setup, one that usually favors Cannon, Bretton Woods and Wildcat. Rain mixes in even up high at times.
Next two days: summit temperatures from {{t:37}} to {{t:59}}, with rain at times.
Bretton Woods usually opens first here, around Nov 15. Cannon gets the most hours cold enough to make snow this week (about 6).
Trend: totals have gone up since yesterday, led by Cannon ({{s:3.8}} to {{s:6.7}}).
NWS Gray forecasters, Friday 1:30 PM: "Beneficial rainfall expands inland tonight with locally heavy rainfall along the coast with more showery conditions expected this weekend."
writeups.outlook: Days 8 to 14: NOAA's outlook leans slightly warmer than normal and slightly drier than normal.

insights.text: First flakes: about {{s:2.3}} at the summit Monday morning to Monday afternoon (models {{r:0.4,6.4}}). The base ({{e:1800}}) mixes with or changes to rain Monday morning: about {{s:0}} there vs {{s:2.3}} up top. Highs stay near {{t:33}} afterward, so some of it should stick up high.
Cold enough to make snow Thursday evening to Thursday night: about 7 hours at or below {{t:26}} at mid-mountain, counting humidity. Whether the guns run is up to the resort.
Typically opens around Nov 27, 21 days out.
